戚明雪表面温柔，心中却暗暗的想着，不愧是女主，她走的时候没有把门关好，没想到她运气这么好，还是让她跑到了这里。

不过她已经把她最大的金手指抢了，她到要看看没有金手指的女主，是不是还是像书里那样的牛逼。

“明雪，你和她说什么，她就是个白眼狼。”顾母抓着戚明雪就走。

“大姨，表妹一个人……”

“你管她做什么，你不知道她昨天怎么说的，我以后没她这个女儿。”

“大姨，怎么说都是一家人，表妹她也是小不懂事，您别和她计较……”

两人的声音渐渐远去，时笙垂着头把玩着手中的铁剑，面前忽然一暗，她微微抬头，对上一双冷漠的眸子。

作为男主，宋拾长得很帅气的，只是对于看过楚棠陆清韵那种美得人神共愤的男人，宋拾这样的她也顶多是觉得比平常人好看一些。

“我的队伍不欢迎你，你现在离开。”宋拾的声音和他的人一样，冷冰冰的，不含丝毫感情。

哎哟我去，戚明雪这是和宋拾说了什么，这就要赶本宝宝走了？

“老大，她一个小姑娘……”苏霁夜的话还没说完，宋拾一个冷眼扫过去，苏霁夜就不敢在说。

时笙扯着嘴角笑了下，从地上将装着白虎的包拎起来，轻声的念着他的名字，“宋拾，宋公子，啧……”

宋拾微微皱眉，这个女生确实很怪，让她离开队伍是正确的选择。

时笙路过顾父顾母的时候，顿了下，“顾先生，我想和你说几句话，可以吗？”

顾父看向顾母，无声的询问，顾母直接厌恶的扭开了头，顾父这才和时笙一起出了超市。

“顾先生，你可以告诉我我的亲身父母是谁吗？”时笙开门见山的问。

闻言，顾父脸色聚变，“小南，你……”从哪里知道的？

原主的母亲程素，是顾父的初恋，父亲是谁，顾父也不知道，当时是程素将刚出生不久的她抱到他家里，求他和顾母收养她。

顾母当时就不乐意，但是程素拿了很大的一笔钱，顾母这才答应。

十几年，程素就跟人间蒸发了一样，再也没见过她。

程素是京城人，她难不成要跑到京城去？

去京城要从Ｂ市过去，而且现在也没飞机。时笙只得先压下这件事，既然能作为支线任务，肯定不是那么好做的。

时笙离开超市，在附近找到一辆房车，里面还有一个丧尸，时笙将丧尸弄出去，开着车跟在戚明雪的队伍后面。

戚明雪和宋拾都知道，但是大路朝天，他们总不能不让她跟吧？

从Ａ市出去，宋拾的人损失了五个，其他人也死了好一些，本来加起来有三十多人，此时也就只剩下十多人，四辆车锐减到两辆车。

出城的时候，遇到了余良和胖子，两人都觉醒了异能，可惜余静和那两个妹纸都死了。

宋拾让两人加入了队伍，看到跟在最后面的时笙，两人都有些诧异，这个姑娘竟然还活着。

Qi Mingxue looked gentle on the surface, but secretly thought in her heart that she was worthy of being the heroine. She didn't close the door when she left. I didn't expect that she was so lucky that she still got here.

But she has already snatched her biggest golden finger. She wants to see if the heroine without the golden finger is still as awesome as in the book.

"Mingxue, what did you say to her? She is just a white-eyed wolf." Gu's mother grabbed Qi Mingxue and left.

"Auntie, my cousin is alone..."

"You don't care what she does. You don't know what she said yesterday. I won't have a daughter like her in the future."

"Auntie, we are all a family after all. My cousin is also young and naive. Don't argue with her..."

The voices of the two gradually faded away. Shi Sheng lowered her head and played with the iron sword in her hand. Suddenly, her eyes dimmed. She raised her head slightly and met a pair of indifferent eyes.

As the male protagonist, Song Shi is very handsome, but for a man like Chu Tang and Lu Qingyun who is so beautiful that people and gods are indignant, she would at most think that Song Shi is better looking than ordinary people.

"You are not welcome in my team, please leave now." Song Shi's voice was as cold as his own, without any emotion.

Oh, let me go, what did Qi Mingxue say to Song Shi, that he is going to drive this baby away now?

"Boss, she's a little girl..." Before Su Jiye could finish his words, Song Shi glanced at her coldly, and Su Jiye didn't dare to say anything.

Shi Sheng smiled with a smile, picked up the bag containing the white tiger from the ground, and whispered his name softly, "Song Shi, Mr. Song, tsk..."

Song Shi frowned slightly. This girl was indeed weird. Letting her leave the team was the right choice.

When Shi Sheng passed by Gu's father and Gu's mother, he paused and said, "Mr. Gu, I want to say a few words to you, is that okay?"

Father Gu looked at Mother Gu and asked silently. Mother Gu turned her head away in disgust. Father Gu then left the supermarket with Shi Sheng.

"Mr. Gu, can you tell me who my biological parents are?" Shi Sheng asked straight to the point.

Hearing this, Father Gu's expression changed, "Xiao Nan, you..." Where did you know that?

The original owner's mother, Cheng Su, was Gu's father's first love. Gu's father didn't know who the father was. It was Cheng Su who brought her to his home shortly after she was born and begged him and Gu's mother to adopt her.

Gu's mother was not happy at the time, but Cheng Su took a large sum of money, and Gu's mother agreed.

For more than ten years, Cheng Su seemed to have disappeared from the world, and she was never seen again.

Cheng Su is from the capital, is it possible that she wants to go to the capital?

To go to the capital, you have to go from City B, and there are no planes now.Shi Sheng had to suppress this matter first. Since it could be used as a side mission, it was definitely not that easy to do.

Shi Sheng left the supermarket and found a RV nearby with a zombie inside. Shi Sheng got the zombie out and followed Qi Mingxue's team in the car.

Qi Mingxue and Song Shi both knew it, but since the road was high, they couldn't help but let her follow, right?

After leaving City A, Song Shi's men lost five, and many others died. Originally, there were more than thirty people in total, but now there were only more than ten people left, and the number of four vehicles dropped sharply to two.

When leaving the city, I met Yu Liang and Fatty, both of whom had awakened their powers. Unfortunately, Yu Jing and the two girls were both dead.

Song Shi asked the two of them to join the team. When they saw Shi Sheng following at the back, they were both a little surprised that this girl was still alive.
